Most annual-report statements are vague (no date, no number), so n is tiny and the score is NOT comparable with concall MCS. See research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/AR_mode_validation.md. Research, not advice.

data.formula: score: delivered +1, partly +0.5, missed -1, moved-goalpost -1.5, silently-dropped -1.5, withdrawn -0.5; weight = specificity(3/2/1) x materiality(1-3) x 0.5^(quarters/8)

title: Promise tracker AR mode (no-concall companies): what annual reports can and cannot score (Nov 2026)
body: Validated on SUNFLAG plus two seeded-random no-concall NSE small caps (GULFPETRO, REPRO). Annual reports carry few checkable promises: hand reads found 7 (GULFPETRO FY25) and 8 (REPRO FY25) forward statements, almost all undated; the pipeline recovered 3/7 and 2/8 at the promise stage (zone 5/7, 3/8). Auto-scored n was 5 (SUNFLAG), 0, 0. The most useful AR-mode outputs are not the MCS but (1) the asset status tracker (SUNFLAG: 17/17 hand-ledger mine-status cells reproduced; the unchanged Belgaon 5.391 MT reserve flagged) and (2) disclosure-quality flags: stale forward dates at filing (REPRO x3), 'done during the year' text repeated across years (SUNFLAG Blooming mill), identical sentences copied year to year. Treat AR-mode MCS as non-comparable with concall MCS. Research, not advice.
